name: Institute of Mental Health (IMH)
languageNote: The provider lists its professional services in Sinhala, Tamil and English. Confirm current availability when contacting them.
description: The institute lists psychological and mental health counselling for teens, couples, adults and older people. Contact the provider about appointments, fees and suitability.

name: Women In Need (WIN)
languageNote: The helpline lists support in Sinhala, Tamil and English. Ask about language availability for counselling appointments.
description: WIN supports women and girls affected by violence and lists psychological, family and trauma counselling. Its helpline is for people facing abuse or violence.

name: National Council for Mental Health
description: The council lists counselling and mental health services. Ask the provider about language, appointments, fees and suitability.
hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM–4:30 PM, excluding public holidays. Confirm before visiting.

name: National Institute of Mental Health
description: NIMH lists a psychological treatment day service. Call to ask about services, referrals, appointments and language availability.
